errors.title: Something went wrong
errors.INVALID_CREDENTIALS: That email and password don't match. Check them and try again.
errors.EMAIL_NOT_CONFIRMED: Please verify your email address before signing in.
errors.USER_EXISTS: An account with this email already exists. Try signing in instead.
errors.WEAK_PASSWORD: That password is too weak. Use at least 10 characters with letters and numbers.
errors.SAME_PASSWORD: Choose a password you haven't used before.
errors.AUTH_LINK_INVALID: This link is invalid or has expired. Request a new one.
errors.PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE: This sign-in option isn't available on this device.
errors.FILE_UNSUPPORTED: This file type isn't supported. Choose a PDF, JPEG or PNG that isn't password-protected.
errors.FILE_TOO_LARGE: This file is too large. PDFs can be up to 25 MB and 200 pages; images up to 10 MB each.
errors.UPLOAD_FAILED: The upload didn't finish. Check your connection and try again.
errors.PDF_RENDER_FAILED: We couldn't read this PDF. It may be damaged. Try exporting it again.
errors.SIGNATURE_LIMIT: You can save up to 5 of each. Delete one in Account → Signatures to save another.
errors.SIGNATURE_TOO_SIMPLE: That's too small to use as a signature. Try again, a little bigger.
errors.NETWORK_OFFLINE: You're offline. Check your connection and try again.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Please wait a moment and try again.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You don't have access to this.
errors.INVALID_STATE: This action isn't available right now. Refresh and try again.
errors.INVALID_INPUT: Some information is missing or invalid. Check it and try again.
errors.NOT_FOUND: We couldn't find that document. It may have been deleted.
errors.UNKNOWN: Something went wrong. Please try again.
